# Functions with a self-modifying DNAS1 region.
# GENERATED by tools/dnas1_decrypt.py -- do not edit by hand.
#
# The body of these functions contains an encrypted region that the
# _sce_dnas_pwrap_main shim (0x5c5030) decrypts at runtime (mprotect RWX ->
# _sce_dnas_pwrap_descramble -> cacheflush -> mprotect RX) and encrypts
# again right after (_sce_dnas_pwrap_scramble). The cipher is
# bit-for-bit the same as DNAS2 (same 8 primitives, same constants
# K1=0x09F8ED17 K2=0xA95128C3, same bank order), so the plaintext is
# readable (`python3 tools/dnas1_decrypt.py` writes the decrypted image).
# Each site also embeds the descriptor (5 words before the region + 3
# after), the encrypted region itself and the `b` jumps around it, which
# gcc cannot emit from C: the build puts that scaffold in place of the
# markers of src/dnas/dnas_prot.h (tools/dnas_subst.py), and the gate
# compares the whole function with the decrypted image, descriptors
# masked (tools/dnas_ref.py). See docs/dnas.md.
#
# 24 functions / 7724 bytes.
